title: 12 Best Natural Wine Bars in Almaty
description: Discover Almaty's top natural wine bars. From cozy bistros to vibrant urban spots, find your perfect pour of organic, biodynamic, and low-intervention wines in Kazakhstan's cultural capital.

places.name: Vinohoh Wine Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Ask the sommelier for a flight of Central European natural wines, paired with their artisan cheese board.

places.name: Ami Wine & Deli
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Enjoy a glass of a crisp Austrian natural Grüner Veltliner with their house-made pastrami sandwich or a selection of cured meats.

places.name: L.V. Wine Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Explore their French natural wine selections, particularly a robust Loire Valley Cabernet Franc, paired with their duck confit.

places.name: B&B Wine Cafe
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Try a refreshing Italian frizzante from their natural wine list with a bruschetta platter.

places.name: Crudo Steakhouse
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A robust biodynamic Malbec or a volcanic Sicilian red to complement their signature Ribeye steak.

places.name: Nedelka
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A light, crisp natural rosé or orange wine from their selection with their signature Shakshuka or any of their vibrant salads.

places.name: Vzletka
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Explore their New World natural wines, perhaps a Chilean unfiltered Sauvignon Blanc, alongside their tuna tartare.

places.name: The Botanist
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A bright, aromatic natural white wine, like a Portuguese Vinho Verde, to pair with their fresh spring rolls or quinoa salad.

places.name: Olivier Restaurant
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A biodynamic Burgundy Pinot Noir to accompany their Beef Bourguignon or a delicate natural Sancerre with the scallops.

places.name: Line Brew
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A rustic, unfiltered German Spätburgunder (Pinot Noir) to go with their signature steak or schnitzel.

places.name: Cozy Corner
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A light-bodied natural rosé or a 'glou-glou' red from their fridge, paired with their popular pastries or a simple quiche.

places.name: Barmaglot
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order An adventurous Japanese or Slovenian natural white wine, paired with their spicy edamame or shrimp dumplings.
